newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end higher on institutional buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end higher on institutional buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended higher in active trading ahead of the weekend on Thursday, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 11 points or 1.15 percent at 960.78 on a turnover of 43.4 million taka. Gainers led losers by 91 to 32.
Dealers said market sentiment was boosted as institutional buyers participated actively. Retailers also gave good support.
Food scrip Pran gained 29.71 taka to 698. Beximco Pharmaceuticals fell 0.38 taka to 116.57 while Chic Textile declined 0.06 to 11.03. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
